chapter.heading: Psalm 121The Lord the Keeper of Israel.A Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
I will
lift up my eyes to the hills [of Jerusalem]—From where shall my help come? [Jer 3:23]

My help
comes from the Lord, Who made heaven and earth.

He will
not allow your foot to slip; He who keeps you will not slumber. [1 Sam 2:9; Ps 127:1; Prov 3:23, 26; Is 27:3]

Behold, He
who keeps Israel Will neither slumber [briefly] nor sleep [soundly].

¶The Lord
is your keeper; The Lord is your shade on your right hand. [Is 25:4]

The sun
will not strike you by day, Nor the moon by night. [Ps 91:5; Is 49:10; Rev 7:16]

The Lord
will protect you from all evil; He will keep your life.

The Lord
will guard your going out and your coming in [everything that you do]From this time forth and forever. [Deut 28:6; Prov 2:8; 3:6]
